sourceRevision: 1ce7bac plus this approved M1.2 implementation; accompanying commit records the slice
scope: Initial internal shape/data contracts; no public entrypoint or compiler/provider migration

red.failure: Missing new contracts/payloads module before implementation
red.note: This records missing-module test-first failure, not a claim that every later adversarial test was independently run against an old implementation

seededProperties.domain: Independent ordered literal artifacts with string/boolean/bounded integer values, source indexes and identity versions
seededProperties.assertions: JSON representation and decoded values equal the independently constructed model; nested unknown identity fields rejected; source input order unchanged

seededProperties.domain: Different-owner qualified references across identity versions
seededProperties.assertions: Artifact rejects mismatched owner; standalone reference data/JSON round trips preserve its own identity

seededProperties.domain: Mixed qualified references, ordered static transforms and shadow offsets
seededProperties.assertions: Independent structured artifacts round trip; added unknown structured fields rejected

boundaryPolicies.unknownFields: error at all nested schema boundaries; no silent stripping
boundaryPolicies.numeric: Finite numbers, safe integer version/location/index domains; negative/fractional native scalars permitted; signed zero rejected at initial JSON boundary; finite numeric text for angles/percentages
boundaryPolicies.descriptors: Same-realm plain/null-prototype records, dense undecorated arrays and own enumerable data fields; no getter/toJSON execution; reject unsupported values/prototypes, cycles and nesting beyond 64 containers
boundaryPolicies.proxyAndCrossRealm: Not provided; Proxy inspection traps are not inert
boundaryPolicies.identity: Complete owner/name/version tuple; qualified reference must match artifact header; data identity does not prove provider/package ownership
boundaryPolicies.encoding: Schema decoding/encoding with ordinary data failure results; typed encode and explicit encodeUnknown; semantic JSON round trip rather than reference/byte round trip
boundaryPolicies.artifactVersion: Literal 1 for internal prototype envelope; other versions fail without fallback; not a published compiler/runtime ABI

typeContracts.positive: Schema-derived readonly identity/declaration/artifact/reference/diagnostic types, typed encode and ordinary ContractResult
typeContracts.negative: Unsupported typed artifact version, missing reference identity, unknown diagnostic code, string source positions, mutation of readonly identity, distinct-representation schema passed to shape codec helper

packedExpo.refresh: Local current tarball installed into retained isolated npm Expo consumer; existing Expo dependency installation reused; current app source copied

runtimeBoundary: Existing emitted declarations contain no Effect imports; theme ESM/CommonJS graphs are React-only; pack-consumer Node16/Bundler and runtime denial tests pass. New internal source codecs execute under Bun tests and are not part of those emitted public graphs.

delivery.M1.2: complete for initial schemas and boundary tests
delivery.nextRecommended: M1.3 emitted Effect boundary loading/graph/initialization qualification; await approval

limits: Shape/property syntax validation is not native primitive/property/value or token-domain admission; those checks remain existing compiler and M2/M3 responsibilities
No public schema/decoder, production schema ingress or atomic theme-update API
No emitted private-contract CJS/oldest-Node loading or Effect initialization measurement; those remain M1.3
No byte canonicalization/hash or class/Proxy/reference-identity round-trip promise
Existing public negative-zero behavior unchanged; migration requires an explicit M2 policy
Packed npm consumer reuses existing Expo dependencies
No new dependency/version change, native/device run, benchmark superiority, publication or push
Preexisting release manifest/package/lockfile version edits excluded
